study_question: Can trivially simple, strictly causal price rules (momentum / mean-reversion computed from completed 1m bars) predict the same attached outcome labels on the same rows where the incumbent stack was scored in Study #1 — and how do they compare to the incumbent head-to-head on identical row sets?

explicitly_not.not_an_admission_packet: PASS here is NOT evidence for decision-path admission. Admission additionally requires an economic study (entry/exit simulation, costs per cost_model_registry_v1, deflated performance) per AGENTS.md decision-path admission.
explicitly_not.not_training: No parameters are fit. Every challenger is a fixed rule declared below; lookbacks are preregistered, not searched.
explicitly_not.not_production_wiring: Report-only. No decision-path effect. governance/decision_path_admissions.json is untouched.

data.decision_rows: calibration_decision_log (read-only) — identical row gates to Study #1 (trusted, RTH, fusion available, outcome attached)
data.price_bars: price_bars_1m (read-only) — challenger inputs use ONLY bars with bar_end_ts_utc <= decision_ts_utc (completed strictly at/before the decision instant)
data.causality_rule: a challenger prediction at decision_ts_utc may consume no information later than decision_ts_utc; the most recent completed bar must end within max_bar_age_sec of the decision or the row is skipped (BAR_GAP) for that challenger
data.row_alignment: incumbent-vs-challenger comparisons are computed on the intersection of rows both scored (identical row sets) — never on mismatched denominators

challengers.momentum_5: sign(close[j] - close[j-5]) -> up/down (j = last completed bar); zero move or insufficient history -> row skipped
challengers.never_flat_note: challengers never predict flat; MCC and the baseline comparisons handle abstention-free predictors honestly

family.multiple_comparison_scope: Holm-Bonferroni across ALL 48 (ticker x horizon x challenger) tests in one declared family

primary_metric.name: MCC (multiclass Matthews correlation, Gorodkin)
advancement_screen_per_test: day-block bootstrap 95% CI of MCC excludes 0 (B=1000, resample ET dates with replacement)
Holm-Bonferroni adjusted bootstrap p < 0.05 across the declared 48-test family
accuracy >= always_flat baseline AND accuracy >= majority_class baseline AND accuracy >= persistence baseline
shuffle control null centered at zero (else STOP: artifact — investigate before any claim)
primary_metric.no_post_hoc_switching: metric, family, challenger definitions, lookbacks, gates, and thresholds are frozen by this file before the run

baselines.majority_class: predict the cell's majority truth class
baselines.persistence: predict the previous scored row's truth label (look-ahead-advantaged, deliberately hard bar — same honesty note as Study #1)
baselines.shuffle_control: truth labels permuted within test (K=200, fixed seed) — must score at chance
baselines.incumbent_reference: the recorded stack dominant_direction rescored on the identical row subset (context metric, not a screen gate)

serial_dependence_honesty.issue: identical to Study #1 — ~1-minute decision cadence vs (N+1)-minute label spans; rows are not independent trials

sample_floors.below_floor_action: test reported as UNDER_SAMPLED; excluded from PASS/FAIL claims

stop_conditions: shuffle control significantly off-center in any test -> STOP (artifact) before interpreting anything else
zero tests meet sample floors -> report INSUFFICIENT_DATA; no claims

outcome_interpretation.test_PASS: a trivial causal rule carries real information at that cell — it becomes a candidate for the economic study AND the minimum bar any complex model must clear there
outcome_interpretation.test_FAIL: that rule carries no detectable signal there — a real finding that narrows the search
outcome_interpretation.incumbent_comparison: mcc_delta_vs_incumbent > 0 on identical rows means a 3-line rule beat the seven-layer stack on its own recorded decisions — a direct, preregistered complexity audit

outputs.authoritative: JSON report; console summary is convenience only
